title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star with Lulu and Owl | Nursery Rhyme
description:
Sing along to Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star with Lulu the little duck by a quiet pond at night! The star twinkles in the water, Owl flaps on every "twinkle", and a little turtle comes to listen.
The words light up with the music, for children aged 2 to 6.
A classic nursery rhyme (words by Jane Taylor, 1806; traditional French tune, 1761).
